speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when the bleeding and abdominal pain started?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. I need to assess the severity of the situation, so please describe the color of the blood and whether it is accompanied by any clots. Also, on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your current pain level?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Vaginal bleeding. I also have Severe abdominal pain, History of contractions that stopped, Previous cesarean delivery.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to assess the baby's well-being immediately. Can you tell me if you are still feeling fetal movements, and have you noticed any fluid leaking from your vagina?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: One previous childbirth via cesarean section. No other significant past medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, occasional alcohol consumption. Works as an elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of a previous cesarean section and the current presentation of severe abdominal pain with vaginal bleeding at 38 weeks, I am highly concerned for uterine rupture. REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound_abdomen REQUEST TEST: Fetal_Heart_Monitoring
